done_when: forge close opens a blocked pull request as a draft and marks it ready for review once its review is clean and its checks are green

findings.body: The PR fixture returns `isDraft` regardless of the requested JSON fields. Removing `isDraft` from `_pull_request` in `src/forge/close.py:162` would therefore leave the promotion tests passing, while real drafts would never be promoted because `pr.get("isDraft")` would return `None`. [GitHub CLI documents](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_pr_list) that `--json` outputs only the specified fields. The stub matches only argument prefixes (`tests/conftest.py:37`), and the existing dependency test (`tests/test_contracts.py:346`) supplies the field unconditionally too. Extend the promotion test to assert that the listing requests `isDraft`, or make its response honor the requested fields, so this essential part of the fix is covered.
findings.title: Not done: draft promotion requires fetching GitHub's draft state

why: A pull request whose review is still blocked looks mergeable on GitHub
